<translate>
'''Dende''' is the guardian of [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]] on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. He teaches no skills; instead he offers healing, a full character reset, Saiyan tails and Kami's Blessing, a Training Point boost for Good-aligned players.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location ==
</translate>
<translate>
Dende lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]], near the world spawn, together with [[Special:MyLanguage/Korin|Korin]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Mr. Popo|Mr. Popo]]. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 3 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout#Finding it|Kami's Lookout]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Services ==
</translate>
<translate>
* '''Heal''': heals you. Like every healing service, it's locked when you're already at full health and doesn't work while you're knocked out after a temporary revive.
* '''Reset Stats''': a full character reset. Dende asks for confirmation first, and the window closes afterwards.
* '''Grow Tail''' / '''Remove Tail''': only for races with a Saiyan tail.
* '''Kami's Blessing''': ×1.2 Training Points for 5 minutes, with a 30-minute cooldown shown as a live timer. Only for Good-aligned players (61 or higher). See [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Points and Mastery|Training Points and Mastery]].
</translate>

{{Config|General Server Config|kamiBlessTpMultiplier}}
<translate>
The blessing's multiplier, duration and cooldown are server defaults.
</translate>

<translate>

</translate>
